evolution.name: ★ Starbreaker
evolution.description: Every 3rd shot fires a massive piercing beam that explodes.

weapons.name: Scatter Shotgun
weapons.description: Short-range cone with heavy knockback.

evolution.description: Fires a devastating wide cone with explosive pellets.

weapons.description: High fire rate, low damage. Crit chance +10%.

weapons.name: Railgun
weapons.description: Slow, devastating, pierces everything in a line.

evolution.name: ★ Event Horizon
evolution.description: Creates a gravity well at the endpoint, pulling and damaging enemies.

weapons.description: Lightning that chains between nearby enemies (3 chains).

evolution.name: ★ Thunder Dominion
evolution.description: Chains to 7 enemies, each chain deals +20% damage.

weapons.name: Flamethrower
weapons.description: Continuous short-range damage that applies burning.

evolution.name: ★ Dragon's Breath
evolution.description: Burns spread to nearby enemies and deal 3× damage.

weapons.name: Rocket Launcher
weapons.description: Explosive projectile with area damage.

evolution.name: ★ Apocalypse Engine
evolution.description: Fires 3 rockets in a spread. Explosions leave lingering fire.

weapons.name: Orbit Blades
weapons.description: 3 orbiting blades damage nearby enemies continuously.

evolution.name: ★ Solar Guillotine
evolution.description: 6 massive orbiting blades + periodic outward slash wave.

weapons.name: Combat Drone
weapons.description: Autonomous drone fires at enemies independently.

evolution.name: ★ Autonomous War Swarm
evolution.description: 4 drones fire in synchronized barrages with homing.

weapons.name: Mine Layer
weapons.description: Drops proximity mines behind you. Detonate on contact.

evolution.name: ★ Dead Zone Protocol
evolution.description: Mines create a persistent minefield. Chain detonations.
